message.content: Hi. I use a screen reader. I'm looking at reselling headphones and want to check some prices later.

content.text: Headphones are a good category to learn on: prices move often and the same model is sold in many places. When you have a pair of headphones in mind, send me its barcode, its Amazon link or its name, and I'll check who sells it and at what price, with the cost before anything runs.
